key_insight: H²R uses hierarchical mathematical hints as intermediate milestones during reinforcement learning to shorten the reasoning horizon and improve multi-step problem solving.
engineering_relevance: For verifiable mathematical tasks, structured sub-question checkpoints offer a way to augment final-answer rewards with intermediate guidance.
method: Exploit mathematical problems’ intrinsic sub-question hierarchy.
Use hierarchical hints as structured conditioning signals during reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards.
Evaluate hint-assisted reasoning on the introduced HiMath benchmark.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports improvements across diverse LLMs without task-specific training; with H²R, Qwen2.5-Math-7B accuracy on HiMath rises from 30.4% to 39.1% using hierarchical hints and reaches 45.6% with Oracle Hierarchical Hints.
watch_item: Performance may depend on access to reliable hierarchical hints; the oracle-hint result should not be treated as evidence of fully autonomous reasoning.
paper_title: H$^2$R: Hierarchical Hint-Based Reward for Mathematical Reasoning via Reinforcement Learning
